## WQGuard v1.3.2 (Build 19)

全面升级**密码学签名链与混合应用资源完整性验真**、**Mach-O/ZIP64 全链路防绕过解析**，并集成 **2026 最新漏洞特征库**、**ARM64 `svc #0x80` 直接系统调用扫描**与 **13 项固件 CVE 暴露雷达**。

---

### 中文更新说明

- **密码学签名链与整包完整性验真（`CSBlobParser` / `ChannelClassifier`）**：
  - 对声称 `cryptid != 0` 的二进制强制执行 **Apple Root CA (G1/G2/G3) SHA-256 锚定**、**CMS `SignerInfo` 公钥验签**、**`CodeDirectory` 逐页哈希校验**、**Slot 5 / Slot 7 双向封条校验**，以及 **Special Slot `-1` (`Info.plist`)** 与 **Special Slot `-3` (`_CodeSignature/CodeResources`)** 全包资源密封核验。
  - 彻底拦截**移植正版苹果 CMS 签名链**、**伪造或剥离 `LC_CODE_SIGNATURE` 假冒 `cryptid = 1` 预侧载包**，以及**在正版 FairPlay 钱包内篡改 `main.jsbundle` / 植入未签名 `drainer.js` 或删除 `CodeResources` 的混合重打包攻击**，同时消除正版 App Store 应用内嵌未加密官方框架的误报。
  - 加固跨架构/多槽位身份一致性判定：屏蔽死 `x86_64` 模拟器切片身份覆盖与单槽 DER 重复键后写遮蔽，采用线性防 DoS + UTF-16 兼容解析 `.mobileprovision` 与 XML Entitlements。
- **Mach-O 静态反逃逸与隐蔽利用链检测（`MachOParser` / `MachOScanner`）**：
  - **ARM64 `svc #0x80` (`0xD4001001`) 直接系统调用指令级扫描 (`INSN_ARM64_SVC_0X80`)**：覆盖 `arm64` / `arm64e` / `arm64_32` 全切片、无节头 `LC_MAIN` 可执行段及自定义 RX 代码段，识别绕过 `libsystem_kernel.dylib` 导入表的内联系统调用。
  - **动态符号与局部 FairPlay 反遮蔽**：支持 `LC_LAZY_LOAD_DYLIB` (`0x20`)、`__TEXT,__stub_helper` 跳转表解析（封堵 `lazy_bind` 死字节遮蔽）、膨胀 `LC_DYLD_CHAINED_FIXUPS` 边界截断保护，并按步进/节窗穿透 `64 KB` CSPRNG 高熵前缀填充，保留未加密 `__TEXT` / `__objc_methname` / `__LINKEDIT` 与 `dlopen` / `NSBundle` + `NSClassFromString` / `NSSelectorFromString` 反射调用的私有 API 检出。
- **ZIP64 / 嵌套子包与 POSIX 容器零解引用防护（`IPAPackageScanner` / `ContainerScanner` / `MCMReader` / `CSStore2Parser`）**：
  - 拦截 ZIP64 EOCD/Locator 双目录多态包、流式跳过 DEFLATE 空块探测伪装资源后缀 Mach-O、识别含越界诱饵切片的多切片 FAT 伪装包，并将深扫范围扩展至 **`AppClips/*.app` / `Watch/*.app` / `.appex` / `.xpc` / `.xcframework`** 与包内目录软链接。
  - 以严格逐分量 POSIX `namei` 语义识别级联软链接与嵌套 `Library/Caches/**` 越界逃逸，`MCMReader`、`CSStore2Parser`、`CLICommandRunner` 与 iOS 端导入流程全线落实 `O_NOFOLLOW | O_NONBLOCK` 防软链接/FIFO 阻塞。
- **注册表、白名单、`lockdownd` 通信与 Brotli 护盾加固**：
  - **2026 本地漏洞全覆盖**：集成 **`CVE-2026-65339`**（`audiomxd` 麦克风静默绕过，零误报公开音频/模拟器）、**`BookRestore` / `bl_sbx` & `MobileGestalt`** 篡改、**`CVE-2026-84493`**（`AccessorySetupKit` 蓝牙 TCC 绕过）与 **13 项 2026 固件 CVE 暴露雷达**（新增追踪 **`CVE-2026-20700`** `dyld` 0-day 与 **`CVE-2026-113897`** WebKit 沙盒逃逸，并精确区分 `iOS 27.3 beta 1` 与 `beta 2+`/正式版补丁边界）。
  - 封堵 TrollStore `iTunesMetadata` / `System` 注册伪装、`devicectl` 缺省签名伪造及未签名/跨源 `TeamID` / `App Group` 寄生白名单投毒；`LockdownInstProxyClient` 强制仅连接本机或私有网段 IP、强制 `EnableSessionSSL` & `EnableServiceSSL` 加密并阻断 `HostCertificate` TLS 反射攻击；`brotli-guard.js` 与代理护盾新增 RFC 9110 分隔符、`dcb` / `x-dcb` / `x-brotli` 阻断与 `-*` 全局排除校验。
- **全量验证**：
  - Swift 6 严格并发模式下 **45 个 XCTest 套件、869 项自动化测试全部通过（0 失败）**，并完成 Release `wqguard-cli` 与 `WQGuard_v1.3.2.ipa` 成品严格自审（`KNOWN_TOOL`）。

---

### English Release Notes

- **Cryptographic Signature Chain & Whole-Bundle Integrity Verification (`CSBlobParser` / `ChannelClassifier`)**:
  - Enforces **Apple Root CA (G1/G2/G3) SHA-256 pinning**, **CMS `SignerInfo` public-key signature verification**, **per-page `CodeDirectory` hash verification**, **bidirectional Slot 5 / Slot 7 sealing**, and **Special Slot `-1` (`Info.plist`) + Special Slot `-3` (`_CodeSignature/CodeResources`)** bundle verification before granting App Store trust.
  - Defeats grafted Apple CMS chains, stripped/malformed `LC_CODE_SIGNATURE` headers masquerading as `cryptid=1`, and hybrid repackaging attacks (e.g., tampering `main.jsbundle`, injecting unsealed `drainer.js`, or deleting `CodeResources` in FairPlay wallet apps) while avoiding false positives on legitimate Apple-signed apps embedding unencrypted frameworks.
  - Ignores dead `x86_64` simulator slices, prevents intra-blob DER key shadowing, and uses linear $O(N)$ UTF-16-capable XML scanning for `.mobileprovision` and Slot 5 entitlements.
- **Mach-O Static Anti-Evasion & 2026 Exploit Coverage (`MachOParser` / `MachOScanner`)**:
  - **ARM64 `svc #0x80` (`0xD4001001`) Direct Syscall Instruction Scanner (`INSN_ARM64_SVC_0X80`)**: Scans 4-byte-aligned executable code across all `arm64` / `arm64e` / `arm64_32` slices, unsectioned `LC_MAIN` segments, and custom RX sections while skipping genuine FairPlay `encryptedRange` intervals.
  - Supports `LC_LAZY_LOAD_DYLIB` (`0x20`), `__TEXT,__stub_helper` lazy-bind trampolines, bounded `LC_DYLD_CHAINED_FIXUPS`, CSPRNG-prefix-resistant partial FairPlay entropy checks, unencrypted `__LINKEDIT` / `__objc_methname` inspection, and `dlopen` / `NSBundle` + `NSClassFromString` / `NSSelectorFromString` dynamic reflection detection.
- **ZIP64, Nested Sub-Bundles & POSIX `namei` Container Forensics (`IPAPackageScanner` / `ContainerScanner` / `MCMReader` / `CSStore2Parser`)**:
  - Blocks ZIP64 dual-CD polyglot archives, streams past empty DEFLATE padding blocks for magic-based asset scanning, handles 3+ slice FAT binaries with OOB decoy slices, and audits nested **`AppClips/*.app` / `Watch/*.app` / `.appex` / `.xpc` / `.xcframework`** sub-bundles and in-bundle directory symlinks.
  - Implements token-by-token POSIX `namei` symlink resolution across nested `Library/Caches/**` trees and enforces `O_NOFOLLOW | O_NONBLOCK` across container metadata, CSStore2 snapshots, CLI outputs, and local UI package imports.
- **Registry, Whitelist, Lockdown TLS & Brotli Shield Hardening**:
  - Covers **`CVE-2026-65339`** (`audiomxd` silent mic TCC bypass, zero false positives on public audio frameworks/emulators), **`BookRestore` / `bl_sbx` & `MobileGestalt`** tampering, **`CVE-2026-84493`** (`AccessorySetupKit` silent Bluetooth bypass), and the **13-CVE 2026 Firmware Posture Radar** (including **`CVE-2026-20700`**, **`CVE-2026-113897`**, and `iOS 27.3 beta 1` vs. `beta 2+`/GA tracking for `0day:worse_query`).
  - Blocks TrollStore `iTunesMetadata` / `System` registration spoofing, `devicectl` default-signer spoofing, unsigned/cross-team `TeamID` & `App Group` whitelist poisoning, Lockdown external/plaintext/reflection attacks (loopback/private-IP-only + mandatory SSL + anti-`HostCertificate` reflection), and RFC 9110 / `dcb` / `x-brotli` header smuggling or `-*` MITM kill-switches.
- **Verification**:
  - `swift test --disable-sandbox -Xswiftc -strict-concurrency=complete`: **45 XCTest suites, 869/869 tests passing, 0 failures**, alongside Release `wqguard-cli` & `WQGuard_v1.3.2.ipa` (`KNOWN_TOOL`) self-audit verification.
